name: catchup
description: Catch-up digest cases for large group chats. Each case pins a fixture cursor (catchup_since_sort_key) so the window is reproducible; the harness never advances the real per-chat cursor.

cases.question: Catch me up on Daily Conversations at Bom Sucesso.
cases.notes: Window covers a possible-flooding warning for Rua Baixa de Monteverde 4 and a fast-running water meter discussion.

cases.question: What happened in Daily Conversations since I last checked?
cases.notes: Window adds the Rua Bela 26-unit sale news on top of the flooding thread.

cases.question: Catch me up on the Fellow Owners chat.
cases.notes: Window covers a golf clubs request and offer, contractor damage along Rua do Sol, and an AGM lowest-price discussion.

cases.question: Anything new with the fellow owners?
cases.notes: Wider window adds the NOS internet outage and Starlink recommendation.

cases.question: Catch me up on Fellow Owners again.
cases.notes: Cursor beyond the newest message: the bot must say there is nothing new, without inventing a digest.
